token.description: The Ably account token used for authentication. Can also be set via the `ABLY_ACCOUNT_TOKEN` environment variable.

url.description: The Ably Control API URL. Can also be set via the `ABLY_URL` environment variable. Defaults to the production API.

app_id.description: The Ably application ID which this key is associated with.

capabilities.description: The capabilities that this key has. More information on capabilities can be found in the [Ably documentation](https://ably.com/docs/core-features/authentication#capabilities-explained)

created.description: The timestamp of when the key was created.

key.description: The complete API key including API secret.

modified.description: Unix timestamp representing the date and time of the last modification of the key.

name.description: The name for your API key. This is a friendly name for your reference.

revocable_tokens.description: Allow tokens issued by this key to be revoked. More information on Token Revocation can be found in the [Ably documentation](https://ably.com/docs/auth/revocation)

status.description: The status of the key. 0 is enabled, 1 is revoked.

account_id.description: The ID of your Ably account.

apns_auth_type.description: The APNS authentication type. Can be 'certificate' or 'token'.

apns_certificate.description: The Apple Push Notification service certificate.

apns_certificate_configured.description: Whether an APNS certificate has been configured.

apns_issuer_key.description: The APNS issuer key (Team ID) used for token-based authentication.

apns_private_key.description: The Apple Push Notification service private key.

apns_signing_key.description: The APNS signing key used for token-based authentication.

apns_signing_key_configured.description: Whether an APNS signing key has been configured.

apns_signing_key_id.description: The APNS signing key ID used for token-based authentication.

apns_topic_header.description: The APNS topic header, typically the app bundle ID.

apns_use_sandbox_endpoint.description: Use the Apple Push Notification service sandbox endpoint.

created.description: The timestamp when the app was created.

fcm_project_id.description: The unique identifier for the Firebase Cloud Messaging(FCM) project. This ID is used to specify the Firebase project when configuring FCM or other Firebase services.

fcm_service_account.description: Used to specify the Firebase Cloud Messaging(FCM) service account credentials used for authentication and enabling communication with FCM to send push notifications to devices.

fcm_service_account_configured.description: Whether a Firebase Cloud Messaging service account has been configured.

modified.description: The timestamp when the app was last modified.

status.description: The application status. Disabled applications will not accept new connections and will return an error to all clients. When creating a new application, ensure that its status is set to enabled.

tls_only.description: Enforce TLS for all connections. This setting overrides any channel setting.

block.description: The `ably_app` resource allows you to create and manage Ably Apps and configure Ably Push notifications. Read more about Ably Push Notifications in Ably documentation: https://ably.com/docs/general/push

status.description: The status of the rule. Rules can be enabled or disabled.

collection.description: What the connector should watch within the database. The connector only supports watching collections.

full_document.description: Controls whether the full document should be included in the published change events. Full Document is not available by default in all types of change event. Possible values are `updateLookup`, `whenAvailable`, `off`. The default is `off`.

full_document_before_change.description: Controls whether the full document before the change should be included in the change event. Full Document before change is not available on all types of change event. Possible values are `whenAvailable` or `off`. The default is `off`.

pipeline.description: A MongoDB pipeline to pass to the Change Stream API. This field allows you to control which types of change events are published, and which channel the change event should be published to. The pipeline must set the _ablyChannel field on the root of the change event. It must also be a valid JSON array of pipeline operations.

primary_site.description: The primary site that the connector will run in. You should choose a site that is close to your database.

url.description: The connection string of your MongoDB instance. (e.g. mongodb://user:pass@myhost.com)

target.description: The target for the ingress rule

block.description: The `ably_ingress_rule_mongodb` resource sets up a MongoDB Integration Rule to stream document changes from a database collection over Ably.

status.description: The status of the rule. Rules can be enabled or disabled.

nodes_table_schema.description: Schema for the nodes table in your database to allow for operation as a cluster to provide fault tolerance.

outbox_table_schema.description: Schema for the outbox table in your database, which allows for the reliable publication of an ordered sequence of change event messages over Ably.

primary_site.description: The primary data center in which to run the integration rule.

ssl_mode.description:
Determines the level of protection provided by the SSL connection. Options are:
  - prefer: Attempt SSL but allow non-SSL.
  - require: Always use SSL but don't verify certificates.
  - verify-ca: Verify server certificate is signed by a trusted CA.
  - verify-full: Verify server certificate and hostname.

Default: prefer.

ssl_root_cert.description: Optional. Specifies the SSL certificate authority (CA) certificates. Required if SSL mode is verify-ca or verify-full.

url.description: The URL for your Postgres database, for example postgres://user:password@example.com:5432/your-database-name. The associated user must have the correct privileges

target.description: The target for the ingress rule

block.description: The `ably_ingress_rule_postgres_outbox` resource Use the Postgres database connector to distribute changes from your Postgres database to end users at scale. It enables you to distribute records using the outbox pattern to large numbers of subscribing clients, in realtime, as the changes occur.

authenticated.description: Require clients to be authenticated to use channels in this namespace.

batching_enabled.description: If true, channels within this namespace will start batching inbound messages instead of sending them out immediately to subscribers as per the configured policy.

batching_interval.description: When configured, sets the maximium batching interval in the channel.

conflation_enabled.description: If true, enables conflation for channels within this namespace. Conflation reduces the number of messages sent to subscribers by combining multiple messages into a single message.

conflation_interval.description: The interval in milliseconds at which messages are conflated. This determines how frequently messages are combined into a single message.

conflation_key.description: The key used to determine which messages should be conflated. Messages with the same conflation key will be combined into a single message.

expose_timeserial.description: If true, messages received on a channel will contain a unique timeserial that can be referenced by later messages for use with message interactions.

id.description: The namespace or channel name that the channel rule will apply to.

mutable_messages.description: Enables message editing and deletion on the namespace. When enabled, messages published to channels matching this namespace can be modified or deleted.

persist_last.description: If true, the last message on each channel will persist for 365 days.

persisted.description: If true, messages will be stored for 24 hours.

populate_channel_registry.description: When enabled, channels matching this namespace will appear in the channel registry, allowing channel enumeration.

push_enabled.description: If true, publishing messages with a push payload in the extras field is permitted.

tls_only.description: If true, only clients that are connected using TLS will be permitted to subscribe.
